packets.title: Move selected frame cells with single-key ripple
packets.responsibility: Moves a selected block by layer/frame offset. A single same-layer key drag expands to every later keyframe, filters locked sources/targets, snapshots full frame records, blanks sources, writes in-range targets, rekeys motion-arc lookup keys, retimes captured interpolated spans and rebuilds the destination frame selection.
packets.writer: Writes state.layers[*].frames, state.motionArcs through rekeyTweenPairData, and _sel.frames. Mutates the caller-supplied selection array by appending later keys in the single-key same-layer ripple path before local locked-layer filtering; reads global selBounds and invokes history, frame-save and render owners.
packets.public_api: window.SM.moveFrames(selection,destinationMinLayer,destinationMinFrame). Return value is undefined for all paths.
packets.oracle: Future independent fixture matrix: empty/no-bounds/no-offset; single-key forward/back ripple and positive-edge clamp; multi-cell and cross-layer no-ripple; locked source, locked target and mixed partial selection; negative/high destinations; full-record clone preservation; two adjacent tween pairs with sparse/dense inbetweens; arc/easing/override keys; destination selection and render calls. Keep current partial/data-loss outcomes explicit. Assert the caller selection array receives the later-key append, including zero-effective-delta cases; independently verify the grid slice protects its original array until destination selection rebuild. A pure planner must return this effect for its adapter to apply.
entangled_with: timeline drag selection construction lines 5108-5202 and drop line 5413
packets.proposed_api: planFrameMove(document,selection,target,{clone}) -> {writes,clears,newSelection,keyPairMoves,appendedRippleSelection}; the application adapter preserves the public caller-array append effect before locked-layer filtering and owns undo/save/rekey/retime/render.

consumer_matrix.save: Calls saveAllLayerFrames after pushUndo; subsequent exportJSON persists moved frame records and global tween metadata.
consumer_matrix.load: importJSON/deserialization owns reconstruction. The move must preserve the complete opaque frame record rather than define a new schema.
consumer_matrix.history: pushUndo() creates a full layers snapshot before mutation and includes motionArcs/tweenEasing/tweenOverrides through C01; the following saveAllLayerFrames call is redundant but current behavior.
consumer_matrix.selection: Computes the offset from global selBounds rather than the explicit selection. The single-key same-layer ripple path appends later keys directly to the caller array before local filtering, even if the eventual effective delta is clamped to zero. The grid caller at line 5413 supplies _sel.frames.slice(), but other public callers observe this mutation. Replaces _sel.frames with in-range destinations afterward.
consumer_matrix.animation: Retimes interpolated frames and calls rekeyTweenPairData, which currently moves only state.motionArcs keys; tweenEasing/tweenOverrides are not rekeyed.
consumer_matrix.render: Calls loadFrame(current), renderOS, renderArcs and updateUI after mutation.
consumer_matrix.export: All stored frames and tween maps flow through exportJSON and downstream animation exporters via existing C01/C02 consumers.
consumer_matrix.native: N/A: no native or system clipboard call.

packets.title: Shift a layer frame array for caller-owned range retiming
packets.responsibility: Rebuilds a fixed-duration layer frame array, shifts nonempty stroke-bearing records by dx, drops records crossing timeline bounds, rekeys motion-arc pair keys and returns whether the request was accepted. It intentionally performs no history/save/render.
packets.writer: Writes state.layers[layerIdx].frames and state.motionArcs through rekeyTweenPairData. Caller separately writes layer in/out points and Motion property/effect keys.
packets.oracle: Future fixture matrix: missing/locked/zero delta; positive/negative shifts; records falling off both edges; nonempty key/interpolated records; empty keyframes and metadata-only component records; motion-arc/easing/override keys. Consumer integration asserts layer-inout takes exactly one pre-drag undo/save, shifts Motion keys once, then load/render once; Motion layer-skew path needs equivalent pre-drag evidence.
packets.proposed_api: shiftLayerFrameRecords(frames,delta,totalFrames) -> {frames,dropped}; caller transaction separately shifts Motion tracks and pair metadata.

consumer_matrix.save: No save inside by design; layer-inout onDown saves before live range changes. SMLayerInOut.retimeLayers and Motion callers must establish the same precondition.

consumer_matrix.selection: Does not update _sel or Motion key selection.
consumer_matrix.animation: Moves only frame records whose strokes array is nonempty; caller separately invokes SMMotion.shiftLayerMotionKeys. rekeyTweenPairData changes motionArcs only.
consumer_matrix.render: No render inside. Layer-inout drop and Motion skew callers own timeline/layer/frame/engine refresh.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: moveFrames blanks every filtered source before its destination loop skips out-of-range targets. UI clamps the drag anchor, not every cell in a multi-selection.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: A selection extending past a destination edge can lose non-anchor source frames.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: Cross-layer moveFrames computes beforeKeyframes, rekeyTweenPairData and retimeTweenSpans with the source layer index even after records are written to another layer.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: Tween spans and arc keys are not transferred coherently to the destination layer.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: rekeyTweenPairData only rewrites state.motionArcs. No relocation method rekeys state.tweenEasing or state.tweenOverrides.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: Per-span easing and manual pair overrides can remain under stale frame-pair keys after relocation.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: moveKeyframe reconstructs each moved record from strokes/isKeyframe/isInterpolated and calls rekeyTweenPairData without layerIdx.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: Other frame fields can be lost, and a non-active layer move can rekey arcs under the active layer identity.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: shiftLayerFrames copies a record only when src.strokes.length is nonzero.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: Empty keys, empty interpolated records and metadata-only component keys disappear during a whole-layer shift.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: pasteFrames selects every in-range destination after writing, while its write pass skips locked layers.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: Locked cells can appear selected as paste destinations even though their contents were unchanged.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: cut/delete blank frame records without rekeying or clearing arc/easing/override maps; locked-only cut/delete still records history and reports an operation.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: Stale tween metadata and no-change undo entries remain possible.

known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.evidence: No test file references any of the seven mapped methods or rekeyTweenPairData.
known_defects_and_unavailable_evidence.impact: All listed behavior fixtures and consumer checks are future, independent oracles and were not run for this data-only census.
